description: Talk to your own Switch Agent, the same one on the Switch Agent page, without opening the app. Send a message in plain words; it answers in its own words and works on your own account with its own tools: pictures, videos, sound, files, your library, your styles and your motion graphics. Name your own styles, motion graphics, folders, voices and saved items by name; the agent finds them on your account, so never ask the person for an id. Pass back conversation_id to continue a conversation; leave it out to start a new one. Work with faces or real people belongs on BytePlus: start that conversation with start_on byteplus, and if a conversation on another brain turns to faces or people, remind the person and start a new one on BytePlus. Hand over a picture or video you already hold an id for with asset_ids. Long work keeps going after the answer returns: read it by calling again with the same conversation_id and an empty message, and when the reply names a task id, read that with get_task_status. When the agent wants to spend tokens, delete something or post, it stops and the answer carries pending_action: only the person can say yes, with their own tap in Switch; you can never approve it. If the answer says still_working, call again with the same conversation_id and an empty message to read the rest. Talking to the agent uses your model time, the same as in the app.

asset_ids.description: Optional: ids of your own pictures or videos to hand to the agent with this message (from list_my_assets, list_my_videos or an upload). Never ask the person for one; a name in the words is enough.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id from an earlier answer, to continue that conversation; leave out to start a new one.

message.description: What to say to your Switch Agent, in plain words. Empty (with conversation_id) to read a conversation that is still going.

start_on.description: Optional, for a new conversation only: astra (Astra 6.2, the default), fable (Fable 5.2), or byteplus for work with faces or real people. A continued conversation keeps its own.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for words before returning (5 to 55, default 45). If it is still working, call again with the same conversation_id.
